meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: Claude 会把 iMessage 适配器复制进 src/channels/ 并注册、安装 chat-adapter-imessage@0.1.1、构建并跑注册测试，再按你选的 local 或 remote 模式写入 .env、重启服务，最后解析你的手机号或 Apple ID 邮箱作为对话地址。
howto.when: 当你提到 “add imessage”、“connect imessage” 等关键词，或要接入 iMessage 通道时触发。local 模式只在 macOS 上可用，其他系统只能选 remote（Photon）。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 加上 iMessage，用 local 模式
say.note: 接着会提示给 Node 授予完全磁盘访问权限

say.text: 接入 iMessage，走 Photon 远程模式
say.note: 需要 Photon 服务器 URL 和 API 密钥
用作对话地址和你的身份

howto.what_en: Claude copies the iMessage adapter into src/channels/, registers it, installs chat-adapter-imessage@0.1.1, builds and runs the registration test, writes .env keys for local or remote mode, restarts it, and resolves your iMessage handle.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon" and similar, or ask to wire iMessage into NanoClaw. Local mode needs macOS; other OSes use remote (Photon).

say_en.text: Add iMessage to NanoClaw in local mode
say_en.note: You'll be asked to grant Node Full Disk Access.

say_en.text: Connect iMessage through Photon remote mode
say_en.note: Needs your Photon server URL and API key.
Used as the conversation address to reach you.
